sloka: एष श्रियम् गच्चति राघवो अद्य।राज प्रसादात् विपुलाम् गमिष्यन् ।एते वयम् सर्व समृद्ध कामा।येषाम् अयम् नो भविता प्रशास्ता ॥२-१६-४४॥
transliteration: eṣa śriyam gaccati rāghavo adya।rāja prasādāt vipulām gamiṣyan ।ete vayam sarva samṛddha kāmā।yeṣām ayam no bhavitā praśāstā ॥2-16-44॥

translations.english: Rama heard these various words of admiration by people who had assembled there, and (witnessed) the rejoicings of the citizens.
